nanchang-university.how_to_apply: Apply online with notarised credentials, transcript, passport copy, health and no-crime certificates, plus recommendations and a study plan for master's and doctoral applicants.

nanchang-university.name: Nanchang University President Scholarship
nanchang-university.coverage: Freshman, excellent undergraduate and graduate categories; amounts not stated
nanchang-university.description: A university scholarship for self-funded students in three categories: new undergraduates (class-based programs prioritised), undergraduates from year two, and master's and doctoral students.
nanchang-university.eligibility: Friendly to China, strong grades and good conduct.

chongqing-normal-university.name: Chongqing Normal University President Scholarship (2026)
chongqing-normal-university.coverage: First class: tuition, shared dorm, fees and 400 RMB a month; second class: tuition and fees
chongqing-normal-university.description: A university-funded scholarship for bachelor's, master's, doctoral and language students. First class for graduate students requires a completed year at the university; first-year graduates receive only second class.
chongqing-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, friendly to China, no criminal record. Bachelor's: high school, 25 or under, CSCA required; master's 35 or under; doctoral 40 or under; language 18 to 50; HSK 4 or 5 by level; no other scholarship.
chongqing-normal-university.how_to_apply: Register on the international student online service system and upload the form, credentials, transcripts, study plan, HSK, recommendations and medical form; the 2026 window was 1 March to 30 May.

chongqing-normal-university.name: Chongqing Municipal Government Mayor Scholarship (via CQNU)
chongqing-normal-university.coverage: 35,000 RMB doctoral, 30,000 master's, 25,000 bachelor's per year
chongqing-normal-university.description: A Chongqing municipal scholarship applied for through the university, payable for the normal length of each degree.
chongqing-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, no other scholarship. Bachelor's 25 or under with the CSCA; master's 35 or under; doctoral 40 or under; language 18 to 50.
chongqing-normal-university.how_to_apply: Use the same online system as the President Scholarship with the Mayor Scholarship form; the 2026 window was 1 March to 30 May.

shanghai-normal-university.name: Shanghai Government Scholarship (Shanghai Normal University)
shanghai-normal-university.coverage: Class A: tuition, housing, insurance, 3,000 or 3,500 RMB a month; class B: tuition and insurance
shanghai-normal-university.description: A Shanghai municipal scholarship run by the university. Class A is full funding for master's and doctoral students; class B is partial and open to bachelor's, master's and doctoral students.
shanghai-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, strong grades, no CSC award. Age under 25 / 35 / 40; Chinese-taught programs need HSK, English-taught IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90 for postgraduates; the CSCA is required; art applicants submit four or five works.
shanghai-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the application site, upload the scholarship form and documents and pay 520 RMB; the 2026 window was 1 January to 31 May, with results by end of August.

shanghai-normal-university.name: SISP Scholarship (Shanghai International Student Pre-college)
shanghai-normal-university.coverage: Tier A: tuition, housing, 2,500 RMB a month, insurance; tier B: tuition and insurance
shanghai-normal-university.description: For a one-year pre-college program (Chinese, maths and CSCA preparation) run by the university for the Shanghai Education Commission, preparing students for undergraduate study at Shanghai universities.
shanghai-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, 17 or over, scholarship applicants under 23 on 1 September 2026, healthy, with a strong high-school record and HSK 3 or above; no other Chinese government scholarship.
shanghai-normal-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the application site with the 520 RMB fee, medical form, certificates, transcripts, statement, CV and recommendations.

guangxi-university.name: China Southern Power Grid Company Scholarship (Guangxi University, 2026)
guangxi-university.coverage: Full: tuition, housing, living costs and insurance, including a Chinese prep year for bachelor's
guangxi-university.description: Co-funded by China Southern Power Grid and the university to train bachelor's students in Electrical Engineering and Automation; master's students study Electrical Engineering, Law or Economics. Teaching is in Chinese, and bachelor's students first take a one-year Chinese course and must pass HSK 4 and the CSCA.
guangxi-university.eligibility: Passport holders from ASEAN countries or students sponsored by the company's overseas projects, healthy with no criminal record. Bachelor's: born after 1 September 1996; master's: bachelor's degree, born after 1 September 1991, HSK 4 (180+).
guangxi-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the online system and choose the scholarship; upload the standard documents plus two recommendations and a study plan for master's applicants; the university and company review and interview. The 2026 deadline was 21 June.

hunan-university.name: Partial Scholarship of Hunan University
hunan-university.coverage: Waives application fee, insurance, tuition and on-campus housing fees
hunan-university.description: A university partial scholarship for degree students (bachelor's 4 years, master's 2.5 years). English-taught majors are Business Administration, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Computer Science; Chinese-taught programs cover all 23 colleges. From an archived 2023 page, so terms may have changed.
hunan-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health; bachelor's aged 18 to 30, master's 18 to 35. HSK 4 for Chinese-taught majors; an English certificate or the university's English test for English-taught ones.
hunan-university.how_to_apply: Register on the online system and upload the diploma, transcripts, passport copy, medical form and police certificate; master's applicants add a study plan and two professor recommendations.

sun-yat-sen-university.name: SYSU Scholarship for International Students (2026)
sun-yat-sen-university.coverage: Tier 1: full tuition plus 30,000 to 42,000 RMB a year stipend; tier 2: tuition; tier 3: half tuition
sun-yat-sen-university.description: A merit award for new students in all 2026 catalogue programs except MPA and MBA. Stipends are 30,000 RMB a year for bachelor's, 36,000 for master's and 42,000 for doctoral students, for the standard program length with an annual review. Recipients pay for housing, utilities, insurance, visa, flights and medical checks. The 2026 window has closed and the 2027 cycle is not yet posted.
sun-yat-sen-university.eligibility: Meet the 2026 enrolment rules with outstanding grades; bachelor's under 25, master's under 35, doctoral under 40; a recommendation from a recognised agency or ambassador in the home country. Holders of CSC, CLEC or MPA scholarships are excluded.
sun-yat-sen-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the international student application system and fill in the scholarship section; qualification review and interview follow, with results about 15 days after the interview.

yunnan-university.name: Yunnan University International Student Scholarship (2026)
yunnan-university.coverage: Full: tuition and on-campus housing; partial: housing plus most of the tuition (5,000 RMB payable)
yunnan-university.description: A scholarship for full-time bachelor's, master's and doctoral students.
yunnan-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese passport holders of good conduct and health; age 18 to 30 (bachelor's), 20 to 40 (master's), 22 to 45 (doctoral); HSK 4 (180+) or IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 90.
yunnan-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the international student service system with the standard documents, a study plan and recommendations; experts review and may test or interview. The 2026 deadline was 30 June.

yunnan-university.name: Yunnan University South and Southeast Asian University Alliance Ambassador Scholarship (2026)
yunnan-university.coverage: Full: tuition and housing; partial: housing plus most of the tuition (5,000 RMB payable)
yunnan-university.description: For students recommended by ambassadors at member universities of the alliance, covering non-degree Chinese language, master's and doctoral study, with the same tiers as the university scholarship.
yunnan-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese passport holders recommended by an alliance-member ambassador; master's 20 to 40, doctoral 22 to 45.
yunnan-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the international student service system with the same documents as the university scholarship.

yunnan-university.name: Yunnan Provincial Government Scholarship (via Yunnan University)
yunnan-university.coverage: Coverage not stated in the brochure; aimed mainly at South and Southeast Asian applicants
yunnan-university.description: A provincial scholarship administered by the university for degree students and Chinese-language non-degree students, mainly for South and Southeast Asian countries though others are welcome.
yunnan-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese, healthy, of good conduct; bachelor's normally under 25, master's under 35, doctoral under 40, non-degree under 55; a CSCA report for bachelor's; HSK 4 (180+) or IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 90.
yunnan-university.how_to_apply: Apply on the international student service system with the provincial scholarship form and standard documents; the university reviews and may interview.

liaoning-normal-university.name: Liaoning Provincial Government Scholarship (Liaoning Normal University)
liaoning-normal-university.coverage: Doctoral only: tuition and housing waived, 3,500 RMB a month, insurance
liaoning-normal-university.description: A provincial scholarship for new doctoral students; students pay their own international travel.
liaoning-normal-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health, studying abroad, with a master's degree and under 40.
liaoning-normal-university.how_to_apply: Submit the forms and notarised diploma, transcripts, study plan and recommendations to the international college between December and the end of February each year.

dalian-university-of-technology.name: DUT International Students Presidential Scholarship (2026-27 intake)
dalian-university-of-technology.coverage: Full (graduate): tuition, housing and 1,500 or 1,800 RMB a month; partial: tuition, with or without housing
dalian-university-of-technology.description: A university-funded scholarship for new bachelor's, master's and doctoral students. Full awards (graduate only) cover tuition, on-campus housing and a monthly allowance; partial awards waive tuition, or tuition and housing. Travel and settlement costs are not covered; annual review applies; holders of CSC, Liaoning Government or ICLTS scholarships are excluded.
dalian-university-of-technology.eligibility: Bachelor's: finished high school with excellent results, under 25. Master's: bachelor's degree, under 35. Doctoral: master's degree, under 40. Applicants outside China submit two recommendation letters from professors.
dalian-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: Complete the online application and the Presidential Scholarship form, and upload the notarised diploma, transcripts, language proof and study plan. The window for master's and doctoral applicants is 1 November 2026 to 15 February 2027; bachelor's applicants have until 30 May 2027.

dalian-university-of-technology.name: Liaoning Provincial Government Scholarship (Dalian University of Technology)
dalian-university-of-technology.coverage: Doctoral only: tuition and housing waived, 3,500 RMB a month, insurance; three years
dalian-university-of-technology.description: A provincial scholarship for new doctoral students, funded for three years; afterwards it may convert to the Presidential Scholarship, subject to review.
dalian-university-of-technology.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health with a recognised master's degree, 40 or under, an excellent record, two professor recommendations and no other Chinese government scholarship.
dalian-university-of-technology.how_to_apply: Apply on the online application system with the provincial form, notarised diploma, transcripts, a study plan of at least 1,000 words signed by a supervisor, two recommendations and the medical form; window 1 November 2026 to 15 February 2027.

tiangong-university.name: Tianjin Municipal Government Scholarship (Tiangong University)
tiangong-university.coverage: Partial: tuition for the first year of bachelor's or three years of master's
tiangong-university.description: A municipal scholarship supporting new international degree students on Chinese-taught or English-taught programs. The university screens documents and holds a video interview; each recipient gets no more than one Chinese government or university scholarship. From an older page, so terms may have changed.
tiangong-university.eligibility: Non-Chinese in good health who choose the university first, or current students; age 18 to 30 (bachelor's), up to 35 (master's), 40 (doctoral).
tiangong-university.how_to_apply: Fill in and sign the form and apply on the online system with the passport, notarised diploma, transcripts, two professor recommendations for postgraduates, medical form and language proof; admitted students pay a 500 RMB registration fee.
